\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Nonpositive curvature implies no conjugate points] 1. ch10:10-7

Suppose $(M,g)$ is a Riemannian manifold with nonpositive sectional curvature. Prove that no point of $M$ has conjugate points along any geodesic. [Hint: Consider derivatives of $|J(t)|^2$ when $J$ is a Jacobi field.] (Used on p. 333.) \end{exercise}
